eventDetail.scope: The Conference SCPOES covers the full spectrum of theoretical and practical aspects of signal processing, communication engineering, power systems, quantum technology, and embedded systems. The conference focuses on intelligent communication systems, advanced hardware design, automatic knowledge acquisition and decision-support systems, evolving computational techniques, accessible user interfaces, and the application of artificial intelligence in areas such as computer vision and biosciences.  SCPOES is inherently interdisciplinary, bringing together researchers, academicians, and industry professionals to exchange ideas, discuss emerging challenges, and share knowledge across these domains. The conference provides an international forum for presenting innovative research and fostering collaboration.
